notes.title: Pre-release Update
notes.content:
[h2]General Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added combat stats to unit descriptions
[*] Added coins per minute description when hovering over coins at the top of the screen
[*] Added a satisfaction breakdown description when hovering over the satisfaction widget at the top panel
[*] Added a breakdown of units when hovering over the beds required/available widget
[*] Added an average income of coins per minute when hovering over the amount of coins widget
[*] Removed the realm overview window (its functionality is now handled by the top panel descriptions)
[*] Added a cheat to spawn an Arquebusier from another dimension
[*] Added a secret cheat to spawn my best friend
[*] Maps that are unrevealed at start don't show a minimap in lobby
[*] Marketplace menu updates faster
[/list]

[h2]AI Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved defensive movement and placement of units
[*] Now uses spells and magi
[*] Now controls the balance between weapons and armor (to stop putting all wood into weapons and having none for building)
[/list]

[h2]Gameplay Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Units move at 25% less speed through shallows and marsh
[*] Replaced 'Thunder' (damage spell) with 'Enchant Boots' (speed buff spell)
[*] Added a new unit 'Pioneer' (trainable in a new building; the Pioneer's Office) that can claim neutral territory without requiring a tower
[*] Garrison % defense bonus is now proportional to the building's hit points (if castle has 100% hitpoints the bonus is 50%, if it has 50% it is 25% and so on)
[*] Units can now only recieve supplies if they are in the borders of their owned or allied territory
[*] Paper Mill building and Paper resource removed - the library now requires hides
[*] Sheep now provide hides in addition to meat and wool, but cost 1 more grain to fully grow up
[*] Omellettes resource removed (Eggs are now food in of themselves)
[*] Value of eggs reduced from 32 to 24
[*] Value of cheese and sausage is now both 36 (from 32 and 39 respectively)
[*] Baked chestnuts resource removed (Chestnuts are now called "Legumes and nuts" and are food in of themselves)
[*] Vesenian culture now has pigs in addition to chickens
[*] Snolúni culture now has chickens in addition to cows (replacing cabbages)
[*] Furniture now requires to make both Hides and Timber
[*] Each culture now has a few unique perks including 1 team wide perk
[*] The more damaged a fortification (like castle or watch tower) is, the less it protects the units inside
[*] Most maps now have partially revealed map
[*] Gifting coins/knowledge/mana no longer requires a marketplace
[*] Woodcutter's Hut now costs 2 stone instead of 2 wood and 1 stone
[*] Milita now cost 10 coins instead of being free
[*] Civilians that are protesting now move out of the way if needed by others to move
[/list]

[h3]Satisfaction Rework[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Satisfaction is now calculated globally per player and is broken down to individual sources of negative or positive satisfaction
[*] Foods now give satisfaction based on how much they are available (if you have 2 peddlers and only 1 has bread but both have fish, the bonus from bread is halved)
[/olist]

[h3]Magic Rework[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Arcane magic tech removed (mage is now a baseline unit available regardless of tech)
[*] There are 4 additional human-specific spells available regardless of magic tech
[*] "Life" magic renamed to "Alchemical" magic
[*] "Death" magic renamed to "Necromantic" magic
[/olist]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed chicken farm mechanics
[*] Fixed gold mine and crystal mine graphics
[*] Fixed units not dying from starvation
[*] Fixed a bug where melee fighters would sometimes not register enemies adjacent to them
[*] Pioneers now work properly and now have to hold shift for pioneers to work
[*] Fixed camera panning via mouse wheel being able to go beyond the map borders
[*] Fixed a bug where units would sometimes stay idle outside despite being assigned to garrisons
[/list]
KNOWN BUG
-AI sometimes builds mines next to where there are no resources to mine

[h2]Graphics Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Units show distinct thought bubbles when going to the barracks to be trained
[*] Wells now show being filled with water if water amount is 5 or above
[*] Replaced torch decorations with lanterns (torches are a neutral doodad now)
[*] Added some missing carry animations
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.105
notes.content:
[h3]General Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Replaced the concept of characters with civilizations as it is better fitting
[*] Hovering over a lake shows the player how many fish there are left

[*] Barracks converts carriers into soldiers instead of creating new units
[*] Militia is now free to train (only requires a carrier to convert from)
[*] Light armored troops cost 60 coins (from 110)
[*] Heavy armored troops cost 80 coins (from 120)
[*] Rebalanced taxes (Gain less gold overall, and satisfaction debuffs are slightly more harsh)
[*] Reserved beds removed (obsolete)
[*] Instant training for more gold removed (obsolete)

[*] Ranged units now register enemies to attack in a half-circle instead of a 45° angled cone

[*] Medicine immunity time reduced from 5 minutes to 2 minutes
[*] Houses now take twice as long to devolve, but the civilians within have -1 satisfaction during this period
[*] Added direct trading between players for intransportable resources (coins, knowledge, mana)
[*] Added characteristic bonuses for each civilization
[*] Spearmen and Halberdiers can no longer occupy garrisons, but are stronger in melee combat
[/list]

[list]
[*] Distributors no longer attends houses if they lack the resources the house needs
[*] Fixed game speed dropdown being disabled unless you wait in the menu for 10 seconds
[*] Fixed the 'saved games' menu (no longer shows scrollbar, deleting saved games asks and works properly)
[*] (there were multiple other bug fixes but sadly i lost the previous changelog file)
[*] Fixed the inn disabling other cultural buildings
[/list]

[h3]Graphics Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added missing flour graphics to grain mill
[*] Added all missing goldsmith's workshop graphics
[*] Fixed Knight's graphics and sideways walking animation
[*] Added hills, new stony terrain and ravine terrains
[*] Changed the design of the necromancer
[/list]

[*] Fixed required beds number not being reduced after a soldier unit dies
[*] Corpse eater plant now properly attacks enemies
[*] Host can no longer swap to AI players when creating a lobby of a saved game
[*] Fixed an issue where the amount of carriers displayed would always increase
[*] Fixed a bug where the distributor wouldn't return to workplace if the road has been disconnected while outside
[*] Fixed serfs not using roads properly when delivering a resource
[*] Administration menu is properly updated on loading a saved game
[/list]

[h3]Graphics Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added missing puppet theatre graphics
[*] Added missing stump graphics for palm trees
[*] Added several missing carry animations to female serfs
[*] Added missing garrisoned crossbowman animations and sprites
[*] Added sound effects to most spells
[*] All units now show their combat stats
[/list]

Have a merry christmas :)

[list]

[/list]
___________________________________________________

[list]
[*] Unwalkable corners are now walkable, meaning streets between buildings are not as crowded anymore
[*] Fisherman now works outside (next to water), and no longer needs to be placed adjacent to water
[*] Farmer crop planting and harvesting speed increased by 68%, which means they can manage larger fields
[*] Reduced the radius of crop & vegetable farms from 8 to 7
[*] Brewer orchard and vineyard harvesting speed increased roughly by 40%, which means they can manage larger yards
[*] Increased rations delivery speed modifiers from -10/0/10/20 % to -15/0/15/30 %
[*] Pitch Cache trap removed ːsteamsadː
[*] Spike Pits now also cause enemies to cower in fear when stepping on them, much like when morale is low

[*] Changed housing capacity from 7/10/13/18 to 9/12/14/15
[*] Performer's Camp collision size reduced to 4x5 from 4x6
[*] The Gallows collision size reduced to 4x4 from 4x6

[*] Bonus satisfaction ːsteamhappyː from entertainment now has a limit of +10
[*] Placing roads and fields now places a path or a rectangle (respectively) if holding mouse (holding shift causes road path to be zigzaggy)
[*] Reduced cost of militia to 90 from 100
[*] Reduced cost of scout to 100 from 200 and their attack damage from 30 to 10
[*] Disabling a building now also releases the workers inside
[*] Civilian arrival speed increases the more empty space there is in the town (with diminishing returns)
[*] Towers, stonecutter's hut, woodcutter's hut, crop farms and fishing lodges cannot catch on fire from events anymore
[*] Bandits now, instead of stealing resources from the main castle, attack and attempt to capture your nearest tower
[*] Amount of bandits spawned reduced from 6-12 to 5-8
[*] Ruffian added to the bandit spawn pool
[*] [i]WASD[/i] can used aswell as arrow keys to move camera
[*] Stop hotkey changed to [i]H[/i]
[/list]
___________________________________________________

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Unit descriptions are properly shown when hovering over their respective train buttons
[*] Fixed [i]<name> has joined[/i] message not showing for clients whenever another player joins a lobby
[*] Soldiers now properly take residence within barracks or the academy
[*] Fixed civilians attacking thieves ːsteamfacepalmː
[*] Fixed thief not returning resources back when killed
[*] Fixed pinging in multiplayer
[*] Fixed hotkey for diplomacy
[*] AI is now properly proactive, making troops faster and attacking enemy players when it feels like
[*] Improved AI spacing out their production chains to avoid clogging the streets
[*] Toggling all wares on/off now properly updates the UI
[/list]
___________________________________________________

[list]
[*] T2 housing name changed from 'Cottage' to 'House'
[*] T3 housing name changed from 'Residence' to 'Luxurious House'
[*] All house tiers have a backyard for the 2 back tiles
[*] Villa building redrawn
[/list]
